sanskrit: नित्यशुद्धचिदानन्दसत्तामात्रोऽहमव्ययः । नित्यबुद्धविशुद्धैकसच्चिदानन्दमस्म्यहम्
translit: nityaśuddhacidānandasattāmātro'hamavyayaḥ | nityabuddhaviśuddhaikasaccidānandamasmyaham
en: I am the mere being of eternal pure consciousness-bliss, imperishable; I am the one eternal, awake, purely being-consciousness-bliss.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am the mere being of eternal pure चैतन्य-bliss, imperishable; I am the one eternal, awake, purely being-चैतन्य-bliss.।

sanskrit: नित्यशेषस्वरूपोऽस्मि सर्वातीतोऽस्म्यहं सदा । रूपातीतस्वरूपोऽस्मि परमाकाशविग्रहः
translit: nityaśeṣasvarūpo'smi sarvātīto'smyahaṃ sadā | rūpātītasvarūpo'smi paramākāśavigrahaḥ
en: I am of the nature of the eternal remainder; I am ever beyond all; I am of the nature beyond form; I am a body of supreme space.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am of the nature of the eternal remainder; I am ever beyond all; I am of the nature beyond form; I am a body of supreme space.।

sanskrit: भूमानन्दस्वरूपोऽस्मि भाषाहीनोऽस्म्यहं सदा । सर्वाधिष्ठानरूपोऽस्मि सर्वदा चिद्घनोऽस्म्यहम्
translit: bhūmānandasvarūpo'smi bhāṣāhīno'smyahaṃ sadā | sarvādhiṣṭhānarūpo'smi sarvadā cidghano'smyaham
en: I am of the nature of the bliss of the fullness; I am ever without speech; I am of the form of the support of all; I am ever a mass of consciousness.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am of the nature of the bliss of the fullness; I am ever without speech; I am of the form of the support of all; I am ever a mass of चैतन्य.।

sanskrit: देहभावविहीनोऽस्मि चिन्ताहीनोऽस्मि सर्वदा । चित्तवृत्तिविहीनोऽहं चिदात्मैकरसोऽस्म्यहम्
translit: dehabhāvavihīno'smi cintāhīno'smi sarvadā | cittavṛttivihīno'haṃ cidātmaikaraso'smyaham
en: I am devoid of body-notion; I am ever devoid of anxiety; I am devoid of mind's modifications; I am of one savor, the Self of consciousness.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am devoid of body-notion; I am ever devoid of anxiety; I am devoid of mind's modifications; I am of one savor, आत्मा of चैतन्य.।

sanskrit: सर्वदृश्यविहीनोऽहं दृग्रूपोऽस्म्यहमेव हि । सर्वदा पूर्णरूपोऽस्मि नित्यतृप्तोऽस्म्यहं सदा
translit: sarvadṛśyavihīno'haṃ dṛgrūpo'smyahameva hi | sarvadā pūrṇarūpo'smi nityatṛpto'smyahaṃ sadā
en: I am devoid of all that is seen; I am indeed of the form of the seer; I am ever of full form; I am ever satisfied.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am devoid of all that is seen; I am indeed of the form of the seer; I am ever of full form; I am ever satisfied.।

sanskrit: अहं ब्रह्मैव सर्वं स्यादहं चैतन्यमेव हि । अहमेवाहमेवास्मि भूमाकाशस्वरूपवान्
translit: ahaṃ brahmaiva sarvaṃ syādahaṃ caitanyameva hi | ahamevāhamevāsmi bhūmākāśasvarūpavān
en: I am Brahman; all would be I; I am consciousness itself; I alone, I alone am, of the nature of the fullness of space.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am परब्रह्म; all would be I; I am चैतन्य itself; I alone, I alone am, of the nature of the fullness of space.।

sanskrit: अहमेव महानात्मा ह्यहमेव परात्परः । अहमन्यवदाभामि ह्यहमेव शरीरवत्
translit: ahameva mahānātmā hyahameva parātparaḥ | ahamanyavadābhāmi hyahameva śarīravat
en: I alone am the great Self; I alone am higher than the highest; I appear as another; I alone am like the body.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I alone am the great Self; I alone am higher than the highest; I appear as another; I alone am like शरीर.।

sanskrit: अहं शिष्यवदाभामि ह्ययं लोकत्रयाश्रयः । अहं कालत्रयातीत अहं वेदैरुपासितः
translit: ahaṃ śiṣyavadābhāmi hyayaṃ lokatrayāśrayaḥ | ahaṃ kālatrayātīta ahaṃ vedairupāsitaḥ
en: I appear like a disciple; this is the support of the three worlds; I am beyond the three times; I am worshipped by the Vedas.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I appear like a disciple; this is the support of the three worlds; I am beyond the three times; I am worshipped by the Vedas.।

sanskrit: अहं शास्त्रेण निर्णीत अहं चित्ते व्यवस्थितः । मत्त्यक्तं नास्ति किञ्चिद्वा मत्त्यक्तं पृथिवी च वा
translit: ahaṃ śāstreṇa nirṇīta ahaṃ citte vyavasthitaḥ | mattyaktaṃ nāsti kiñcidvā mattyaktaṃ pṛthivī ca vā
en: I am determined by scripture; I am established in the mind; nothing is apart from me; nothing is abandoned by me, nor the earth.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am determined by scripture; I am established in मन; nothing is apart from me; nothing is abandoned by me, nor the earth.।

sanskrit: मयातिरिक्तं यद्यद्वा तत्तन्नास्तीति निश्चिनु । अहं ब्रह्मास्मि सिद्धोऽस्मि नित्यशुद्धोऽस्म्यहं सदा
translit: mayātiriktaṃ yadyadvā tattannāstīti niścinu | ahaṃ brahmāsmi siddho'smi nityaśuddho'smyahaṃ sadā
en: Whatever is other than me — be certain it does not exist; I am Brahman, I am perfected, I am ever eternally pure.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Whatever is other than me — be certain it does not exist; I am परब्रह्म, I am perfected, I am ever eternally pure.।

sanskrit: निर्गुणः केवलात्मास्मि निराकारोऽस्म्यहं सदा । केवलं ब्रह्ममात्रोऽस्मि ह्यजरोऽस्म्यमरोऽस्म्यहम्
translit: nirguṇaḥ kevalātmāsmi nirākāro'smyahaṃ sadā | kevalaṃ brahmamātro'smi hyajaro'smyamaro'smyaham
en: I am the attributeless, the Self alone; I am ever formless; I am Brahman alone; I am ageless, I am deathless.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am the attributeless, आत्मा alone; I am ever formless; I am परब्रह्म alone; I am ageless, I am deathless.।

sanskrit: स्वयमेव स्वयं भामि स्वयमेव सदात्मकः । स्वयमेवात्मनि स्वस्थः स्वयमेव परा गतिः
translit: svayameva svayaṃ bhāmi svayameva sadātmakaḥ | svayamevātmani svasthaḥ svayameva parā gatiḥ
en: By myself I shine by myself; by myself I am ever being; by myself I rest in the Self; by myself the supreme goal.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: By myself I shine by myself; by myself I am ever being; by myself I rest in आत्मा; by myself the supreme goal.।

sanskrit: स्वयमेव स्वयं भञ्जे स्वयमेव स्वयं रमे । स्वयमेव स्वयं ज्योतिः स्वयमेव स्वयं महः
translit: svayameva svayaṃ bhañje svayameva svayaṃ rame | svayameva svayaṃ jyotiḥ svayameva svayaṃ mahaḥ
en: By myself I break by myself; by myself I delight by myself; by myself I am light by myself; by myself I am splendor by myself.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: By myself I break by myself; by myself I delight by myself; by myself I am light by myself; by myself I am splendor by myself.।

sanskrit: स्वस्यात्मनि स्वयं रंस्ये स्वात्मन्येव विलोकये । स्वात्मन्येव सुखासीनः स्वात्ममात्रावशेषकः
translit: svasyātmani svayaṃ raṃsye svātmanyeva vilokaye | svātmanyeva sukhāsīnaḥ svātmamātrāvaśeṣakaḥ
en: In my own Self I shall delight by myself; in my own Self alone I shall look; seated happy in my own Self, with only my Self remaining.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: In my own Self I shall delight by myself; in my own Self alone I shall look; seated happy in my own Self, with only my Self remaining.।

sanskrit: स्वचैतन्ये स्वयं स्थास्ये स्वात्मराज्ये सुखे रमे । स्वात्मसिंहासने स्थित्वा स्वात्मनोऽन्यन्न चिन्तये
translit: svacaitanye svayaṃ sthāsye svātmarājye sukhe rame | svātmasiṃhāsane sthitvā svātmano'nyanna cintaye
en: In my own consciousness I shall stay by myself; in the kingdom of my own Self I shall delight in bliss; seated on the throne of my own Self, I shall think of nothing else than the Self.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: In my own चैतन्य I shall stay by myself; in the kingdom of my own Self I shall delight in bliss; seated on the throne of my own Self, I shall think of nothing else than आत्मा.।

sanskrit: चिद्रूपमात्रं ब्रह्मैव सच्चिदानन्दमद्वयम् । आनन्दघन एवाहमहं ब्रह्मास्मि केवलम्
translit: cidrūpamātraṃ brahmaiva saccidānandamadvayam | ānandaghana evāhamahaṃ brahmāsmi kevalam
en: Mere form of consciousness is Brahman, being-consciousness-bliss, non-dual; I am a mass of bliss; I am Brahman alone.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Mere form of चैतन्य is परब्रह्म, being-चैतन्य-bliss, non-dual; I am a mass of bliss; I am परब्रह्म alone.।

sanskrit: सर्वदा सर्वशून्योऽहं सर्वात्मानन्दवानहम् । नित्यानन्दस्वरूपोऽहमात्माकाशोऽस्मि नित्यदा
translit: sarvadā sarvaśūnyo'haṃ sarvātmānandavānaham | nityānandasvarūpo'hamātmākāśo'smi nityadā
en: I am ever void of all; I am blissful as the Self of all; I am of the nature of eternal bliss; I am ever the space of the Self.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am ever void of all; I am blissful as आत्मा of all; I am of the nature of eternal bliss; I am ever the space of आत्मा.।

sanskrit: अहमेव हृदाकाशश्चिदादित्यस्वरूपवान् । आत्मनात्मनि तृप्तोऽस्मि ह्यरूपोऽस्म्यहमव्ययः
translit: ahameva hṛdākāśaścidādityasvarūpavān | ātmanātmani tṛpto'smi hyarūpo'smyahamavyayaḥ
en: I alone am the space of the heart, of the nature of the sun of consciousness; by the Self I am satisfied in the Self; I am formless and imperishable.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I alone am the space of हृदय-गुहा, of the nature of the sun of चैतन्य; by आत्मा I am satisfied in आत्मा; I am formless and imperishable.।

sanskrit: एकसङ्ख्याविहीनोऽस्मि नित्यमुक्तस्वरूपवान् । आकाशादपि सूक्ष्मोऽहमाद्यन्ताभाववानहम्
translit: ekasaṅkhyāvihīno'smi nityamuktasvarūpavān | ākāśādapi sūkṣmo'hamādyantābhāvavānaham
en: I am devoid of the number one; I am of the nature of eternally liberated; I am subtler than space; I am devoid of beginning and end.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am devoid of the number one; I am of the nature of eternally liberated; I am subtler than space; I am devoid of beginning and end.।

sanskrit: सर्वप्रकाशरूपोऽहं परावरसुखोऽस्म्यहम् । सत्तामात्रस्वरूपोऽहं शुद्धमोक्षस्वरूपवान्
translit: sarvaprakāśarūpo'haṃ parāvarasukho'smyaham | sattāmātrasvarūpo'haṃ śuddhamokṣasvarūpavān
en: I am of the form of the light of all; I am the bliss of the high and low; I am of the nature of mere being; I am of the nature of pure liberation.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am of the form of the light of all; I am the bliss of the high and low; I am of the nature of mere being; I am of the nature of pure मोक्ष.।

sanskrit: सत्यानन्दस्वरूपोऽहं ज्ञानानन्दघनोऽस्म्यहम् । विज्ञानमात्ररूपोऽहं सच्चिदानन्दलक्षणः
translit: satyānandasvarūpo'haṃ jñānānandaghano'smyaham | vijñānamātrarūpo'haṃ saccidānandalakṣaṇaḥ
en: I am of the nature of true bliss; I am a mass of knowledge-bliss; I am of the form of mere knowledge; I am marked by being-consciousness-bliss.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am of the nature of true bliss; I am a mass of ज्ञान-bliss; I am of the form of mere ज्ञान; I am marked by being-चैतन्य-bliss.।

sanskrit: ब्रह्ममात्रमिदं सर्वं ब्रह्मणोऽन्यन्न किञ्चन । तदेवाहं सदानन्दं ब्रह्मैवाहं सनातनम्
translit: brahmamātramidaṃ sarvaṃ brahmaṇo'nyanna kiñcana | tadevāhaṃ sadānandaṃ brahmaivāhaṃ sanātanam
en: All this is only Brahman; nothing is other than Brahman; that alone I am, ever bliss; I am Brahman, the eternal.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: All this is only परब्रह्म; nothing is other than परब्रह्म; that alone I am, ever bliss; I am परब्रह्म, the eternal.।

sanskrit: त्वमित्येतत्तदित्येतन्मत्तोऽन्यन्नास्ति किञ्चन । चिच्चैतन्यस्वरूपोऽहमहमेव शिवः परः
translit: tvamityetattadityetanmatto'nyannāsti kiñcana | ciccaitanyasvarūpo'hamahameva śivaḥ paraḥ
en: "You," "that" — nothing is other than me; I am of the nature of consciousness; I alone am Shiva, the supreme.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: You," "that" — nothing is other than me; I am of the nature of चैतन्य; I alone am Shiva, the supreme.।

sanskrit: अतिभावस्वरूपोऽहमहमेव सुखात्मकः । साक्षिवस्तुविहीनत्वात्साक्षित्वं नास्ति मे सदा
translit: atibhāvasvarūpo'hamahameva sukhātmakaḥ | sākṣivastuvihīnatvātsākṣitvaṃ nāsti me sadā
en: I am of the nature of beyond-being; I alone am of the nature of happiness; devoid of a thing to be witnessed, I have no witness-hood ever.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am of the nature of beyond-being; I alone am of the nature of happiness; devoid of a thing to be witnessed, I have no witness-hood ever.।

sanskrit: केवलं ब्रह्ममात्रत्वादहमात्मा सनातनः । अहमेवादिशेषोऽहमहं शेषोऽहमेव हि
translit: kevalaṃ brahmamātratvādahamātmā sanātanaḥ | ahamevādiśeṣo'hamahaṃ śeṣo'hameva hi
en: Being Brahman alone, I am the eternal Self; I alone am the primal remainder; I alone am the remainder.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Being परब्रह्म alone, I am the eternal Self; I alone am the primal remainder; I alone am the remainder.।

sanskrit: नामरूपविमुक्तोऽहमहमानन्दविग्रहः । इन्द्रियाभावरूपोऽहं सर्वभावस्वरूपकः
translit: nāmarūpavimukto'hamahamānandavigrahaḥ | indriyābhāvarūpo'haṃ sarvabhāvasvarūpakaḥ
en: I am freed from name and form; I am a body of bliss; I am of the form of absence of senses; I am of the nature of all existence.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am freed from name and form; I am a body of bliss; I am of the form of absence of senses; I am of the nature of all existence.।

sanskrit: बन्धमुक्तिविहीनोऽहं शाश्वतानन्दविग्रहः । आदिचैतन्यमात्रोऽहमखण्डैकरसोऽस्म्यहम्
translit: bandhamuktivihīno'haṃ śāśvatānandavigrahaḥ | ādicaitanyamātro'hamakhaṇḍaikaraso'smyaham
en: I am devoid of bondage and liberation; I am a body of eternal bliss; I am mere primal consciousness; I am of undivided one savor.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am devoid of bondage and मोक्ष; I am a body of eternal bliss; I am mere primal चैतन्य; I am of undivided one savor.।

sanskrit: वाङ्मनोऽगोचरश्चाहं सर्वत्र सुखवानहम् । सर्वत्र पूर्णरूपोऽहं भूमानन्दमयोऽस्म्यहम्
translit: vāṅmano'gocaraścāhaṃ sarvatra sukhavānaham | sarvatra pūrṇarūpo'haṃ bhūmānandamayo'smyaham
en: I am beyond speech and mind; I am blissful everywhere; I am of full form everywhere; I am made of the bliss of the fullness.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am beyond speech and mind; I am blissful everywhere; I am of full form everywhere; I am made of the bliss of the fullness.।

sanskrit: सर्वत्र तृप्तिरूपोऽहं परामृतरसोऽस्म्यहम् । एकमेवाद्वितीयं सद्ब्रह्मैवाहं न संशयः
translit: sarvatra tṛptirūpo'haṃ parāmṛtaraso'smyaham | ekamevādvitīyaṃ sadbrahmaivāhaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
en: I am of the form of satisfaction everywhere; I am the savor of supreme nectar; the one without a second, being, Brahman alone am I; no doubt.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am of the form of satisfaction everywhere; I am the savor of supreme nectar; the one without a second, being, परब्रह्म alone am I; no doubt.।

sanskrit: सर्वशून्यस्वरूपोऽहं सकलागमगोचरः । मुक्तोऽहं मोक्षरूपोऽहं निर्वाणसुखरूपवान्
translit: sarvaśūnyasvarūpo'haṃ sakalāgamagocaraḥ | mukto'haṃ mokṣarūpo'haṃ nirvāṇasukharūpavān
en: I am of the nature of the void of all; I am the object of all scriptures; I am free, I am of the form of liberation, I have the form of the bliss of nirvana.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am of the nature of the void of all; I am the object of all scriptures; I am free, I am of the form of मोक्ष, I have the form of the bliss of nirvana.।

sanskrit: सत्यविज्ञानमात्रोऽहं सन्मात्रानन्दवानहम् । तुरीयातीतरूपोऽहं निर्विकल्पस्वरूपवान्
translit: satyavijñānamātro'haṃ sanmātrānandavānaham | turīyātītarūpo'haṃ nirvikalpasvarūpavān
en: I am mere true knowledge; I am blissful with mere being; I am of a form beyond the Fourth; I am of the nature of non-conception.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am mere true ज्ञान; I am blissful with mere being; I am of a form beyond the Fourth; I am of the nature of non-conception.।

sanskrit: सर्वदा ह्यजरूपोऽहं नीरागोऽस्मि निरञ्जनः । अहं शुद्धोऽस्मि बुद्धोऽस्मि नित्योऽस्मि प्रभुरस्म्यहम्
translit: sarvadā hyajarūpo'haṃ nīrāgo'smi nirañjanaḥ | ahaṃ śuddho'smi buddho'smi nityo'smi prabhurasmyaham
en: I am ever of unborn form; I am passionless, stainless; I am pure, I am awake, I am eternal, I am the lord.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am ever of unborn form; I am passionless, stainless; I am pure, I am awake, I am eternal, I am the lord.।

sanskrit: ओङ्कारार्थस्वरूपोऽस्मि निष्कलङ्कमयोऽस्म्यहम् । चिदाकारस्वरूपोऽस्मि नाहमस्मि न सोऽस्म्यहम्
translit: oṅkārārthasvarūpo'smi niṣkalaṅkamayo'smyaham | cidākārasvarūpo'smi nāhamasmi na so'smyaham
en: I am of the nature of the meaning of Om; I am made of the stainless; I am of the nature of the form of consciousness; I am not "I," nor am I "he."
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am of the nature of the meaning of Om; I am made of the stainless; I am of the nature of the form of चैतन्य; I am not "I," nor am I "he.।

sanskrit: न हि किञ्चित्स्वरूपोऽस्मि निर्व्यापारस्वरूपवान् । निरंशोऽस्मि निराभासो न मनो नेन्द्रियोऽस्म्यहम्
translit: na hi kiñcitsvarūpo'smi nirvyāpārasvarūpavān | niraṃśo'smi nirābhāso na mano nendriyo'smyaham
en: I am of no particular nature; I am of the nature of non-action; I am partless, without appearance; I am neither mind nor sense.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am of no particular nature; I am of the nature of non-action; I am partless, without appearance; I am neither mind nor sense.।

sanskrit: न बुद्धिर्न विकल्पोऽहं न देहादित्रयोऽस्म्यहम् । न जाग्रत्स्वप्नरूपोऽहं न सुषुप्तिस्वरूपवान्
translit: na buddhirna vikalpo'haṃ na dehāditrayo'smyaham | na jāgratsvapnarūpo'haṃ na suṣuptisvarūpavān
en: I am neither intellect nor conception; I am not the three bodies; I am not of the form of waking or dream, nor of the nature of deep sleep.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am neither intellect nor conception; I am not the three bodies; I am not of the form of waking or dream, nor of the nature of deep sleep.।

sanskrit: न तापत्रयरूपोऽहं नेषणात्रयवानहम् । श्रवणं नास्ति मे सिद्धेर्मननं च चिदात्मनि
translit: na tāpatrayarūpo'haṃ neṣaṇātrayavānaham | śravaṇaṃ nāsti me siddhermananaṃ ca cidātmani
en: I am not of the form of the three afflictions; I do not have the three desires; for the Self of consciousness I have no hearing or reflection that perfects.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am not of the form of the three afflictions; I do not have the three desires; for आत्मा of चैतन्य I have no hearing or reflection that perfects.।

sanskrit: सजातीयं न मे किञ्चिद्विजातीयं न मे क्वचित् । स्वगतं च न मे किञ्चिन्न मे भेदत्रयं क्वचित्
translit: sajātīyaṃ na me kiñcidvijātīyaṃ na me kvacit | svagataṃ ca na me kiñcinna me bhedatrayaṃ kvacit
en: I have nothing of the same kind, nothing of a different kind anywhere; nothing within myself; I have the three kinds of difference nowhere.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I have nothing of the same kind, nothing of a different kind anywhere; nothing within myself; I have the three kinds of difference nowhere.।

sanskrit: असत्यं हि मनोरूपमसत्यं बुद्धिरूपकम् । अहङ्कारमसिद्धीति नित्योऽहं शाश्वतो ह्यजः
translit: asatyaṃ hi manorūpamasatyaṃ buddhirūpakam | ahaṅkāramasiddhīti nityo'haṃ śāśvato hyajaḥ
en: The form of mind is unreal, the form of intellect is unreal; ego is not established — I am eternal, everlasting, unborn.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: The form of mind is unreal, the form of intellect is unreal; ego is not established — I am eternal, everlasting, unborn.।

sanskrit: देहत्रयमसद्विद्धि कालत्रयमसत्सदा । गुणत्रयमसत्विद्धि ह्ययं सत्यात्मकः शुचिः
translit: dehatrayamasadviddhi kālatrayamasatsadā | guṇatrayamasatviddhi hyayaṃ satyātmakaḥ śuciḥ
en: Know the three bodies to be unreal; the three times are always unreal; know the three qualities to be unreal; this one is of the nature of truth, pure.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Know the three bodies to be unreal; the three times are always unreal; know the three qualities to be unreal; this one is of the nature of truth, pure.।

sanskrit: श्रुतं सर्वमसत्द्विद्धि वेदं सर्वमसत्सदा । शास्त्रं सर्वमसत्द्विद्धि ह्यहं सत्यचिदात्मकः
translit: śrutaṃ sarvamasatdviddhi vedaṃ sarvamasatsadā | śāstraṃ sarvamasatdviddhi hyahaṃ satyacidātmakaḥ
en: Know all that is heard to be unreal; all Veda is always unreal; know all scripture to be unreal; I am of the nature of true consciousness.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Know all that is heard to be unreal; all Veda is always unreal; know all scripture to be unreal; I am of the nature of true चैतन्य.।

sanskrit: मूर्तित्रयमसद्विद्धि सर्वभूतमसत्सदा । सर्वतत्त्वमसद्विद्धि ह्ययं भूमा सदाशिवः
translit: mūrtitrayamasadviddhi sarvabhūtamasatsadā | sarvatattvamasadviddhi hyayaṃ bhūmā sadāśivaḥ
en: Know the three forms to be unreal; all beings are always unreal; know all principles to be unreal; this is the fullness, Sadashiva.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Know the three forms to be unreal; all beings are always unreal; know all principles to be unreal; this is the fullness, Sadashiva.।

sanskrit: गुरुशिष्यमसद्विद्धि गुरोर्मन्त्रमसत्ततः । यद्दृश्यं तदसद्विद्धि न मां विद्धि तथाविधम्
translit: guruśiṣyamasadviddhi gurormantramasattataḥ | yaddṛśyaṃ tadasadviddhi na māṃ viddhi tathāvidham
en: Know teacher and disciple to be unreal, and the teacher's mantra then unreal; whatever is seen, know it as unreal; do not know me as of that kind.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Know teacher and disciple to be unreal, and गुरुदेव's mantra then unreal; whatever is seen, know it as unreal; do not know me as of that kind.।

sanskrit: यच्चिन्त्यं तदसद्विद्धि यन्न्यायं तदसत्सदा । यद्धितं तदसद्विद्धि न मां विद्धि तथाविधम्
translit: yaccintyaṃ tadasadviddhi yannyāyaṃ tadasatsadā | yaddhitaṃ tadasadviddhi na māṃ viddhi tathāvidham
en: Know whatever is thought to be unreal; whatever is reasoning is always unreal; whatever is beneficial, know it as unreal; do not know me as of that kind.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Know whatever is thought to be unreal; whatever is reasoning is always unreal; whatever is beneficial, know it as unreal; do not know me as of that kind.।

sanskrit: सर्वान्प्राणानसद्विद्धि सर्वान्भोगानसत्त्विति । दृष्टं श्रुतमसद्विद्धि ओतं प्रोतमसन्मयम्
translit: sarvānprāṇānasadviddhi sarvānbhogānasattviti | dṛṣṭaṃ śrutamasadviddhi otaṃ protamasanmayam
en: Know all breaths to be unreal, all pleasures unreal; know the seen and heard as unreal; the woven and interwoven as made of the unreal.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Know all breaths to be unreal, all pleasures unreal; know the seen and heard as unreal; the woven and interwoven as made of the unreal.।

sanskrit: कार्याकार्यमसद्विद्धि नष्टं प्राप्तमसन्मयम् । दुःखादुःखमसद्विद्धि सर्वासर्वमन्मयम्
translit: kāryākāryamasadviddhi naṣṭaṃ prāptamasanmayam | duḥkhāduḥkhamasadviddhi sarvāsarvamanmayam
en: Know what is to be done and not to be done as unreal; what is lost and gained as made of the unreal; know pain and no-pain as unreal; all and not-all as made of the unreal.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Know what is to be done and not to be done as unreal; what is lost and gained as made of the unreal; know pain and no-pain as unreal; all and not-all as made of the unreal.।

sanskrit: पूर्णापूर्णमसद्विद्धि धर्माधर्ममसन्मयम् । लाभालाभावसद्विद्धि जयाजयमसन्मयम्
translit: pūrṇāpūrṇamasadviddhi dharmādharmamasanmayam | lābhālābhāvasadviddhi jayājayamasanmayam
en: Know full and not-full as unreal; merit and demerit as made of the unreal; know gain and loss as unreal; victory and defeat as made of the unreal.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Know full and not-full as unreal; merit and demerit as made of the unreal; know gain and loss as unreal; victory and defeat as made of the unreal.।

sanskrit: शब्दं सर्वमसद्विद्धि स्पर्शं सर्वमसत्सदा । रूपं सर्वमसद्विद्धि रसं सर्वमसन्मयम्
translit: śabdaṃ sarvamasadviddhi sparśaṃ sarvamasatsadā | rūpaṃ sarvamasadviddhi rasaṃ sarvamasanmayam
en: Know all sound as unreal; all touch is always unreal; know all form as unreal; all taste as made of the unreal.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Know all sound as unreal; all touch is always unreal; know all form as unreal; all taste as made of the unreal.।

sanskrit: गन्धं सर्वमसद्विद्धि सर्वाज्ञानमसन्मयम् । असदेव सदा सर्वमसदेव भवोद्भवम्
translit: gandhaṃ sarvamasadviddhi sarvājñānamasanmayam | asadeva sadā sarvamasadeva bhavodbhavam
en: Know all smell as unreal; all ignorance as made of the unreal; all is always only unreal; the arising of becoming is only unreal.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Know all smell as unreal; all अविद्या as made of the unreal; all is always only unreal; the arising of becoming is only unreal.।

sanskrit: असदेव गुणं सर्वं सन्मात्रमहमेव हि । स्वात्ममन्त्रं सदा पश्येत्स्वात्ममन्त्रं सदाभ्यसेत्
translit: asadeva guṇaṃ sarvaṃ sanmātramahameva hi | svātmamantraṃ sadā paśyetsvātmamantraṃ sadābhyaset
en: All qualities are only unreal; I alone am mere being. One should always see the mantra of one's own Self; one should always practice the mantra of one's own Self.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: All qualities are only unreal; I alone am mere being. One should always see the mantra of one's own Self; one should always practice the mantra of one's own Self.।

sanskrit: अहं ब्रह्मास्मि मन्त्रोऽयं दृश्यपापं विनाशयेत् । अहं ब्रह्मास्मि मन्त्रोऽयमन्यमन्त्रं विनाशयेत्
translit: ahaṃ brahmāsmi mantro'yaṃ dṛśyapāpaṃ vināśayet | ahaṃ brahmāsmi mantro'yamanyamantraṃ vināśayet
en: This mantra "I am Brahman" destroys the sin of the seen; this mantra "I am Brahman" destroys other mantras.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: This mantra "I am परब्रह्म" destroys the sin of the seen; this mantra "I am परब्रह्म" destroys other mantras.।

sanskrit: अहं ब्रह्मास्मि मन्त्रोऽयं देहदोषं विनाशयेत् । अहं ब्रह्मास्मि मन्त्रोऽयं जन्मपापं विनाशयेत्
translit: ahaṃ brahmāsmi mantro'yaṃ dehadoṣaṃ vināśayet | ahaṃ brahmāsmi mantro'yaṃ janmapāpaṃ vināśayet
en: This mantra "I am Brahman" destroys the faults of the body; this mantra "I am Brahman" destroys the sin of birth.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: This mantra "I am परब्रह्म" destroys the faults of शरीर; this mantra "I am परब्रह्म" destroys the sin of birth.।

sanskrit: अहं ब्रह्मास्मि मन्त्रोऽयं मृत्युपाशं विनाशयेत् । अहं ब्रह्मास्मि मन्त्रोऽयं द्वैतदुःखं विनाशयेत्
translit: ahaṃ brahmāsmi mantro'yaṃ mṛtyupāśaṃ vināśayet | ahaṃ brahmāsmi mantro'yaṃ dvaitaduḥkhaṃ vināśayet
en: This mantra "I am Brahman" destroys the noose of death; this mantra "I am Brahman" destroys the sorrow of duality.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: This mantra "I am परब्रह्म" destroys the noose of death; this mantra "I am परब्रह्म" destroys the sorrow of duality.।

sanskrit: अहं ब्रह्मास्मि मन्त्रोऽयं भेदबुद्धिं विनाशयेत् । अहं ब्रह्मास्मि मन्त्रोऽयं चिन्तादुःखं विनाशयेत्
translit: ahaṃ brahmāsmi mantro'yaṃ bhedabuddhiṃ vināśayet | ahaṃ brahmāsmi mantro'yaṃ cintāduḥkhaṃ vināśayet
en: This mantra "I am Brahman" destroys the notion of difference; this mantra "I am Brahman" destroys the sorrow of anxiety.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: This mantra "I am परब्रह्म" destroys the notion of difference; this mantra "I am परब्रह्म" destroys the sorrow of anxiety.।

sanskrit: अहं ब्रह्मास्मि मन्त्रोऽयं बुद्धिव्याधिं विनाशयेत् । अहं ब्रह्मास्मि मन्त्रोऽयं चित्तबन्धं विनाशयेत्
translit: ahaṃ brahmāsmi mantro'yaṃ buddhivyādhiṃ vināśayet | ahaṃ brahmāsmi mantro'yaṃ cittabandhaṃ vināśayet
en: This mantra "I am Brahman" destroys the disease of the intellect; this mantra "I am Brahman" destroys the bondage of the mind.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: This mantra "I am परब्रह्म" destroys the disease of बुद्धि; this mantra "I am परब्रह्म" destroys the bondage of मन.।

sanskrit: अहं ब्रह्मास्मि मन्त्रोऽयं सर्वव्याधीन्विनाशयेत् । अहं ब्रह्मास्मि मन्त्रोऽयं सर्वशोकं विनाशयेत्
translit: ahaṃ brahmāsmi mantro'yaṃ sarvavyādhīnvināśayet | ahaṃ brahmāsmi mantro'yaṃ sarvaśokaṃ vināśayet
en: This mantra "I am Brahman" destroys all diseases; this mantra "I am Brahman" destroys all grief.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: This mantra "I am परब्रह्म" destroys all diseases; this mantra "I am परब्रह्म" destroys all grief.।

sanskrit: अहं ब्रह्मास्मि मन्त्रोऽयं कामादीन्नाशयेत्क्षणात् । अहं ब्रह्मास्मि मन्त्रोऽयं क्रोधशक्तिं विनाशयेत्
translit: ahaṃ brahmāsmi mantro'yaṃ kāmādīnnāśayetkṣaṇāt | ahaṃ brahmāsmi mantro'yaṃ krodhaśaktiṃ vināśayet
en: This mantra "I am Brahman" destroys desire and the rest in a moment; this mantra "I am Brahman" destroys the power of anger.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: This mantra "I am परब्रह्म" destroys desire and the rest in a moment; this mantra "I am परब्रह्म" destroys the power of anger.।

sanskrit: अहं ब्रह्मास्मि मन्त्रोऽयं चित्तवृत्तिं विनाशयेत् । अहं ब्रह्मास्मि मन्त्रोऽयं सङ्कल्पादीन्विनाशयेत्
translit: ahaṃ brahmāsmi mantro'yaṃ cittavṛttiṃ vināśayet | ahaṃ brahmāsmi mantro'yaṃ saṅkalpādīnvināśayet
en: This mantra "I am Brahman" destroys the modifications of the mind; this mantra "I am Brahman" destroys intention and the rest.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: This mantra "I am परब्रह्म" destroys the modifications of मन; this mantra "I am परब्रह्म" destroys intention and the rest.।

sanskrit: अहं ब्रह्मास्मि मन्त्रोऽयं कोटिदोषं विनाशयेत् । अहं ब्रह्मास्मि मन्त्रोऽयं सर्वतन्त्रं विनाशयेत्
translit: ahaṃ brahmāsmi mantro'yaṃ koṭidoṣaṃ vināśayet | ahaṃ brahmāsmi mantro'yaṃ sarvatantraṃ vināśayet
en: This mantra "I am Brahman" destroys crores of faults; this mantra "I am Brahman" destroys every other system.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: This mantra "I am परब्रह्म" destroys crores of faults; this mantra "I am परब्रह्म" destroys every other system.।

sanskrit: अहं ब्रह्मास्मि मन्त्रोऽयमात्माज्ञानं विनाशयेत् । अहं ब्रह्मास्मि मन्त्रोऽयमात्मलोकजयप्रदः
translit: ahaṃ brahmāsmi mantro'yamātmājñānaṃ vināśayet | ahaṃ brahmāsmi mantro'yamātmalokajayapradaḥ
en: This mantra "I am Brahman" destroys ignorance of the Self; this mantra "I am Brahman" gives conquest of the world of the Self.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: This mantra "I am परब्रह्म" destroys अविद्या of आत्मा; this mantra "I am परब्रह्म" gives conquest of the world of आत्मा.।

sanskrit: अहं ब्रह्मास्मि मन्त्रोऽयमप्रतर्क्यसुखप्रदः । अहं ब्रह्मास्मि मन्त्रोऽयमजडत्वं प्रयच्छति
translit: ahaṃ brahmāsmi mantro'yamapratarkyasukhapradaḥ | ahaṃ brahmāsmi mantro'yamajaḍatvaṃ prayacchati
en: This mantra "I am Brahman" gives happiness beyond argument; this mantra "I am Brahman" gives non-dullness.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: This mantra "I am परब्रह्म" gives happiness beyond argument; this mantra "I am परब्रह्म" gives non-dullness.।

sanskrit: अहं ब्रह्मास्मि मन्त्रोऽयमनात्मासुरमर्दनः । अहं ब्रह्मास्मि वज्रोऽयमनात्माख्यगिरीन्हरेत्
translit: ahaṃ brahmāsmi mantro'yamanātmāsuramardanaḥ | ahaṃ brahmāsmi vajro'yamanātmākhyagirīnharet
en: This mantra "I am Brahman" crushes the demons of the non-Self; this "I am Brahman" is a thunderbolt that shatters the mountains called non-Self.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: This mantra "I am परब्रह्म" crushes the demons of the non-Self; this "I am परब्रह्म" is a thunderbolt that shatters the mountains called non-Self.।

sanskrit: अहं ब्रह्मास्मि मन्त्रोऽयमनात्माख्यासुरान्हरेत् । अहं ब्रह्मास्मि मन्त्रोऽयं सर्वांस्तान्मोक्षयिष्यति
translit: ahaṃ brahmāsmi mantro'yamanātmākhyāsurānharet | ahaṃ brahmāsmi mantro'yaṃ sarvāṃstānmokṣayiṣyati
en: This mantra "I am Brahman" removes the demons called non-Self; this mantra "I am Brahman" will free them all.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: This mantra "I am परब्रह्म" removes the demons called non-Self; this mantra "I am परब्रह्म" will free them all.।

sanskrit: अहं ब्रह्मास्मि मन्त्रोऽयं ज्ञानानन्दं प्रयच्छति । सप्तकोटिमहामन्त्रं जन्मकोटिशतप्रदम्
translit: ahaṃ brahmāsmi mantro'yaṃ jñānānandaṃ prayacchati | saptakoṭimahāmantraṃ janmakoṭiśatapradam
en: This mantra "I am Brahman" gives knowledge-bliss; it is the great mantra of seven crores, giving a hundred crores of births.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: This mantra "I am परब्रह्म" gives ज्ञान-bliss; it is the great mantra of seven crores, giving a hundred crores of births.।

sanskrit: सर्वमन्त्रान्समुत्सृज्य एतं मन्त्रं समभ्यसेत् । सद्यो मोक्षमवाप्नोति नात्र सन्देहमण्वपि
translit: sarvamantrānsamutsṛjya etaṃ mantraṃ samabhyaset | sadyo mokṣamavāpnoti nātra sandehamaṇvapi
en: Abandoning all mantras, one should practice this mantra; one attains liberation at once — there is not even an atom of doubt.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Abandoning all mantras, one should practice this mantra; one attains मोक्ष at once — there is not even an atom of doubt.।

sanskrit: कुमारः परमेश्वरं पप्रच्छ जीवन्मुक्तविदेहमुक्तयोः स्थितिमनुब्रूहीति । स होवाच परः शिवः । चिदात्माहं परात्माहं निर्गुणोऽहं परात्परः । आत्ममात्रेण यस्तिष्ठेत्स जीवन्मुक्त उच्यते
translit: kumāraḥ parameśvaraṃ papraccha jīvanmuktavidehamuktayoḥ sthitimanubrūhīti | sa hovāca paraḥ śivaḥ | cidātmāhaṃ parātmāhaṃ nirguṇo'haṃ parātparaḥ | ātmamātreṇa yastiṣṭhetsa jīvanmukta ucyate
en: Kumara asked the Supreme Lord: "Tell me the state of the liberated-while-living and the bodiless liberated." The Supreme Shiva said: I am the Self of consciousness, I am the Supreme Self, I am attributeless, I am higher than the highest. He who stays as the Self alone is called liberated while living.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Kumara पूछा परमेश्वर: "Tell me the state of the liberated-while-living and the bodiless liberated." The Supreme Shiva कहा: I am आत्मा of चैतन्य, I am परमात्मा, I am attributeless, I am higher than the highest. He who stays as आत्मा alone कहलाता है liberated while living.।

sanskrit: देहत्रयातिरिक्तोऽहं शुद्धचैतन्यमस्म्यहम् । ब्रह्माहमिति यस्यान्तः स जीवनमुक्त उच्यते
translit: dehatrayātirikto'haṃ śuddhacaitanyamasmyaham | brahmāhamiti yasyāntaḥ sa jīvanamukta ucyate
en: I am beyond the three bodies; I am pure consciousness. He in whom there is inwardly "I am Brahman" is called liberated while living.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am beyond the three bodies; I am pure चैतन्य. He in whom there is inwardly "I am परब्रह्म" कहलाता है liberated while living.।

sanskrit: आनन्दघनरूपोऽस्मि परानन्दघनोऽस्म्यहम् । यस्य देहादिकं नास्ति यस्य ब्रह्मेति निश्चयः । परमानन्दपूर्णो यः स जीवन्मुक्त उच्यते
translit: ānandaghanarūpo'smi parānandaghano'smyaham | yasya dehādikaṃ nāsti yasya brahmeti niścayaḥ | paramānandapūrṇo yaḥ sa jīvanmukta ucyate
en: I am of the form of a mass of bliss; I am a mass of supreme bliss. He who has no body and the like, who has the certainty "Brahman," who is full of supreme bliss, is called liberated while living.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am of the form of a mass of bliss; I am a mass of supreme bliss. He who has no body and the like, who has the certainty "परब्रह्म," who is full of supreme bliss, कहलाता है liberated while living.।

sanskrit: यस्य किञ्चिदहं नास्ति चिन्मात्रेणावतिष्ठते । चैतन्यमात्रो यस्यान्तश्चिन्मात्रैकस्वरूपवान्
translit: yasya kiñcidahaṃ nāsti cinmātreṇāvatiṣṭhate | caitanyamātro yasyāntaścinmātraikasvarūpavān
en: He in whom there is no "I" of anything, who stays as mere consciousness, whose inner self is mere consciousness, of the single nature of mere consciousness,
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: He in whom there is no "I" of anything, who stays as mere चैतन्य, whose inner self is mere चैतन्य, of the single nature of mere चैतन्य,।

sanskrit: सर्वत्र पूर्णरूपात्मा सर्वत्रात्मावशेषकः । आनन्दरतिरव्यक्तः परिपूर्णश्चिदात्मकः
translit: sarvatra pūrṇarūpātmā sarvatrātmāvaśeṣakaḥ | ānandaratiravyaktaḥ paripūrṇaścidātmakaḥ
en: whose self is of full form everywhere, who is the Self remaining everywhere, delighting in bliss, unmanifest, wholly full, of the nature of consciousness,
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: whose self is of full form everywhere, who is आत्मा remaining everywhere, delighting in bliss, unmanifest, wholly full, of the nature of चैतन्य,।

sanskrit: शुद्धचैतन्यरूपात्मा सर्वसङ्गविवर्जितः । नित्यानन्दः प्रसन्नात्मा ह्यन्यचिन्ताविवर्जितः ॥ ६ किञ्चिदस्तित्वहीनो यः स जीवन्मुक्त उच्यते । न मे चित्तं न मे बुद्धिर्नाहङ्कारो न चेन्द्रियम्
translit: śuddhacaitanyarūpātmā sarvasaṅgavivarjitaḥ | nityānandaḥ prasannātmā hyanyacintāvivarjitaḥ || 6 kiñcidastitvahīno yaḥ sa jīvanmukta ucyate | na me cittaṃ na me buddhirnāhaṅkāro na cendriyam
en: of the form of pure consciousness, free of all attachment, of eternal bliss, serene, free of other thoughts, devoid of any trace of existence — he is called liberated while living. "Mine is not the mind, not the intellect, not the ego, not the senses.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: of the form of pure चैतन्य, free of all attachment, of eternal bliss, serene, free of other thoughts, devoid of any trace of existence — he कहलाता है liberated while living. "Mine is not मन, not बुद्धि, not the ego, not इन्द्रियाँ.।

sanskrit: न मे देहः कदाचिद्वा न मे प्राणादयः क्वचित् । न मे माया न मे कामो न मे क्रोधः परोऽस्म्यहम्
translit: na me dehaḥ kadācidvā na me prāṇādayaḥ kvacit | na me māyā na me kāmo na me krodhaḥ paro'smyaham
en: "Mine is not the body at any time; not the breath and the rest anywhere; not illusion is mine, not desire, not anger — I am the supreme.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Mine is not शरीर at any time; not the breath and the rest anywhere; not illusion is mine, not desire, not anger — I am the supreme.।

sanskrit: न मे किञ्चिदिदं वापि न मे किञ्चित्क्वचिज्जगत् । न मे दोषो न मे लिङ्गं न मे चक्षुर्न मे मनः
translit: na me kiñcididaṃ vāpi na me kiñcitkvacijjagat | na me doṣo na me liṅgaṃ na me cakṣurna me manaḥ
en: "Mine is not anything this; mine is not any world anywhere; not fault is mine, not mark, not eye, not mind.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Mine is not anything this; mine is not any world anywhere; not fault is mine, not mark, not eye, not mind.।

sanskrit: न मे श्रोत्रं न मे नासा न मे जिह्वा न मे करः । न मे जाग्रन्न मे स्वप्नं न मे कारणमण्वपि
translit: na me śrotraṃ na me nāsā na me jihvā na me karaḥ | na me jāgranna me svapnaṃ na me kāraṇamaṇvapi
en: "Mine is not ear, nose, tongue or hand; not waking, not dream, not even an atom of the cause.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Mine is not ear, nose, tongue or hand; not waking, not dream, not even an atom of the cause.।

sanskrit: न मे तुरीयमिति यः स जीवन्मुक्त उच्यते । इदं सर्वं न मे किञ्चिदयं सर्वं न मे क्वचित्
translit: na me turīyamiti yaḥ sa jīvanmukta ucyate | idaṃ sarvaṃ na me kiñcidayaṃ sarvaṃ na me kvacit
en: "Mine is not even the Fourth" — he who thus knows is called liberated while living. "All this is nothing of mine; this all is nowhere mine.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Mine is not even the Fourth" — he who thus knows कहलाता है liberated while living. "All this is nothing of mine; this all is nowhere mine.।

sanskrit: न मे कालो न मे देशो न मे वस्तु न मे मतिः । न मे स्नानं न मे सन्ध्या न मे दैवं न मे स्थलम्
translit: na me kālo na me deśo na me vastu na me matiḥ | na me snānaṃ na me sandhyā na me daivaṃ na me sthalam
en: "Mine is not time, not place, not thing, not thought; not bathing, not twilight prayer, not deity, not place.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Mine is not time, not place, not thing, not thought; not bathing, not twilight prayer, not deity, not place.।

sanskrit: न मे तीर्थं न मे सेवा न मे ज्ञानं न मे पदम् । न मे बन्धो न मे जन्म न मे वाक्यं न मे रविः
translit: na me tīrthaṃ na me sevā na me jñānaṃ na me padam | na me bandho na me janma na me vākyaṃ na me raviḥ
en: "Mine is not pilgrimage, not service, not knowledge, not state; not bondage, not birth, not word, not the sun.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Mine is not pilgrimage, not service, not ज्ञान, not state; not bondage, not birth, not word, not the sun.।

sanskrit: न मे पुण्यं न मे पापं न मे कार्यं न मे शुभम् । ने मे जीव इति स्वात्मा न मे किञ्चिज्जगत्रयम्
translit: na me puṇyaṃ na me pāpaṃ na me kāryaṃ na me śubham | ne me jīva iti svātmā na me kiñcijjagatrayam
en: "Mine is not merit, not sin, not work, not the auspicious; not 'I am the individual' — the Self is mine; nothing of the three worlds is mine.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Mine is not merit, not sin, not work, not the auspicious; not 'I am the individual' — आत्मा is mine; nothing of the three worlds is mine.।

sanskrit: न मे मोक्षो न मे द्वैतं न मे वेदो न मे विधिः । न मेऽन्तिकं न मे दूरं न मे बोधो न मे रहः
translit: na me mokṣo na me dvaitaṃ na me vedo na me vidhiḥ | na me'ntikaṃ na me dūraṃ na me bodho na me rahaḥ
en: "Mine is not liberation, not duality, not the Veda, not the rite; not near, not far, not awakening, not secret.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Mine is not मोक्ष, not duality, not the Veda, not the rite; not near, not far, not awakening, not secret.।

sanskrit: न मे गुरुर्न मे शिष्यो न मे हीनो न चाधिकः । न मे ब्रह्म न मे विष्णुर्न मे रुद्रो न चन्द्रमाः
translit: na me gururna me śiṣyo na me hīno na cādhikaḥ | na me brahma na me viṣṇurna me rudro na candramāḥ
en: "Mine is not teacher, not disciple, not inferior, not superior; not Brahma, not Vishnu, not Rudra, not the moon.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Mine is not teacher, not disciple, not inferior, not superior; not Brahma, not Vishnu, not Rudra, not the moon.।

sanskrit: न मे पृथ्वी न मे तोयं न मे वायुर्न मे वियत् । न मे वह्निर्न मे गोत्रं न मे लक्ष्यं न मे भवः
translit: na me pṛthvī na me toyaṃ na me vāyurna me viyat | na me vahnirna me gotraṃ na me lakṣyaṃ na me bhavaḥ
en: "Mine is not earth, not water, not wind, not space; not fire, not lineage, not aim, not becoming.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Mine is not earth, not water, not wind, not space; not fire, not lineage, not aim, not becoming.।

sanskrit: न मे ध्याता न मे ध्येयं न मे ध्यानं न मे मनुः । न मे शीतं न मे चोष्णं न मे तृष्णा न मे क्षुधा
translit: na me dhyātā na me dhyeyaṃ na me dhyānaṃ na me manuḥ | na me śītaṃ na me coṣṇaṃ na me tṛṣṇā na me kṣudhā
en: "Mine is not the meditator, not the object of meditation, not meditation, not the mantra; not cold, not heat, not thirst, not hunger.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Mine is not the meditator, not the object of ध्यान/उपासना, not ध्यान/उपासना, not the mantra; not cold, not heat, not thirst, not hunger.।

sanskrit: न मे मित्रं न मे शत्रुर्न मे मोहो न मे जयः । न मे पूर्वं न मे पश्चान्न मे चोर्ध्वं न मे दिशः
translit: na me mitraṃ na me śatrurna me moho na me jayaḥ | na me pūrvaṃ na me paścānna me cordhvaṃ na me diśaḥ
en: "Mine is not friend, not enemy, not delusion, not victory; not before, not after, not above, not the directions.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Mine is not friend, not enemy, not delusion, not victory; not before, not after, not above, not the directions.।

sanskrit: न मे वक्तव्यमल्पं वा न मे श्रोतव्यमण्वपि । न मे गन्तव्यमीषद्वा न मे ध्यातव्यमण्वपि
translit: na me vaktavyamalpaṃ vā na me śrotavyamaṇvapi | na me gantavyamīṣadvā na me dhyātavyamaṇvapi
en: "Mine is nothing to be said, even slight; nothing to be heard, even an atom; nothing to go to, even slightly; nothing to be meditated on, even an atom.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Mine is nothing to be कहा, even slight; nothing to be heard, even an atom; nothing to go to, even slightly; nothing to be meditated on, even an atom.।

sanskrit: न मे भोक्तव्यमीषद्वा न मे स्मर्तव्यमण्वपि । न मे भोगो न मे रागो न मे यागो न मे लयः
translit: na me bhoktavyamīṣadvā na me smartavyamaṇvapi | na me bhogo na me rāgo na me yāgo na me layaḥ
en: "Mine is nothing to be enjoyed, even slightly; nothing to be remembered, even an atom; not pleasure, not attachment, not sacrifice, not dissolution.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Mine is nothing to be enjoyed, even slightly; nothing to be remembered, even an atom; not pleasure, not attachment, not sacrifice, not dissolution.।

sanskrit: न मे मौर्ख्यं न मे शान्तं न मे बन्धो न मे प्रियम् । न मे मोदः प्रमोदो वा न मे स्थूलं न मे कृशम्
translit: na me maurkhyaṃ na me śāntaṃ na me bandho na me priyam | na me modaḥ pramodo vā na me sthūlaṃ na me kṛśam
en: "Mine is not foolishness, not peace, not bondage, not the dear; not joy or great joy; not stout, not thin.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Mine is not foolishness, not peace, not bondage, not the dear; not joy or great joy; not stout, not thin.।

sanskrit: न मे दीर्घं न मे ह्रस्वं न मे वृद्धिर्न मे क्षयः । अध्यारोपोऽपवादो वा न मे चैकं न मे बहु
translit: na me dīrghaṃ na me hrasvaṃ na me vṛddhirna me kṣayaḥ | adhyāropo'pavādo vā na me caikaṃ na me bahu
en: "Mine is not long, not short; not growth, not decay; superimposition or retraction is not mine; not one, not many.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Mine is not long, not short; not growth, not decay; superimposition or retraction is not mine; not one, not many.।

sanskrit: न मे आन्ध्यं न मे मान्द्यं न मे पट्विदमण्वपि । न मे मांसं न मे रक्तं न मे मेदो न मे ह्यसृक्
translit: na me āndhyaṃ na me māndyaṃ na me paṭvidamaṇvapi | na me māṃsaṃ na me raktaṃ na me medo na me hyasṛk
en: "Mine is not blindness, not dullness, not even an atom of cleverness; not flesh, not blood, not fat, not marrow.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Mine is not blindness, not dullness, not even an atom of cleverness; not flesh, not blood, not fat, not marrow.।

sanskrit: न मे मज्जा न मेऽस्थिर्वा न मे त्वग्धातु सप्तकम् । न मे शुक्लं न मे रक्तं न मे नीलं नमे पृथक्
translit: na me majjā na me'sthirvā na me tvagdhātu saptakam | na me śuklaṃ na me raktaṃ na me nīlaṃ name pṛthak
en: "Mine is not marrow, not bone, not skin — the seven constituents; not white, not red, not blue, not separate.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Mine is not marrow, not bone, not skin — the seven constituents; not white, not red, not blue, not separate.।

sanskrit: न मे तापो न मे लाभो मुख्यं गौणं न मे क्वचित् । न मे भ्रान्तिर्न मे स्थैर्यं न मे गुह्यं न मे कुलम्
translit: na me tāpo na me lābho mukhyaṃ gauṇaṃ na me kvacit | na me bhrāntirna me sthairyaṃ na me guhyaṃ na me kulam
en: "Mine is not heat, not gain; the primary and secondary are nowhere mine; not delusion, not steadiness, not secret, not family.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Mine is not heat, not gain; the primary and secondary are nowhere mine; not delusion, not steadiness, not secret, not family.।

sanskrit: न मे त्याज्यं न मे ग्राह्यं न मे हास्यं न मे नयः । न मे वृत्तं न मे ग्लानिर्न मे शोष्यं न मे सुखम्
translit: na me tyājyaṃ na me grāhyaṃ na me hāsyaṃ na me nayaḥ | na me vṛttaṃ na me glānirna me śoṣyaṃ na me sukham
en: "Mine is not to be abandoned, not to be taken; not laughable, not policy; not conduct, not weariness, not dryness, not pleasure.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Mine is not to be abandoned, not to be taken; not laughable, not policy; not conduct, not weariness, not dryness, not pleasure.।

sanskrit: न मे ज्ञाता न मे ज्ञानं न मे ज्ञेयं न मे स्वयम् । न मे तुभ्यं नमे मह्यं न मे त्वं च न मे त्वहम्
translit: na me jñātā na me jñānaṃ na me jñeyaṃ na me svayam | na me tubhyaṃ name mahyaṃ na me tvaṃ ca na me tvaham
en: "Mine is not knower, not knowledge, not knowable, not self; not for you, not for me; not you and not I.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Mine is not knower, not ज्ञान, not knowable, not self; not for you, not for me; not you and not I.।

sanskrit: न मे जरा न मे बाल्यं न मे यौवनमण्वपि । अहं ब्रह्मास्म्यहं ब्रह्मास्म्यहं ब्रह्मेति निश्चयः
translit: na me jarā na me bālyaṃ na me yauvanamaṇvapi | ahaṃ brahmāsmyahaṃ brahmāsmyahaṃ brahmeti niścayaḥ
en: "Mine is not old age, not childhood, not even an atom of youth. I am Brahman, I am Brahman — thus is the certainty.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Mine is not old age, not childhood, not even an atom of youth. I am परब्रह्म, I am परब्रह्म — thus is the certainty.।

sanskrit: चिदहं चिदहं चेति स जीवन्मुक्त उच्यते । ब्रह्मैवाहं चिदेवाहं परो वाहं न संशयः
translit: cidahaṃ cidahaṃ ceti sa jīvanmukta ucyate | brahmaivāhaṃ cidevāhaṃ paro vāhaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
en: "I am consciousness, I am consciousness" — he who thus holds is called liberated while living. "I am Brahman alone, I am consciousness alone, or I am the supreme" — no doubt.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am चैतन्य, I am चैतन्य" — he who thus holds कहलाता है liberated while living. "I am परब्रह्म alone, I am चैतन्य alone, or I am the supreme" — no doubt.।

sanskrit: स्वयमेव स्वयं हंसः स्वयमेव स्वयं स्थितः । स्वयमेव स्वयं पश्येत्स्वात्मराज्ये सुखं वसेत्
translit: svayameva svayaṃ haṃsaḥ svayameva svayaṃ sthitaḥ | svayameva svayaṃ paśyetsvātmarājye sukhaṃ vaset
en: By himself the swan, by himself established; by himself one should see by oneself; one should dwell in bliss in the kingdom of one's own Self.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: By himself the swan, by himself established; by himself one should see by oneself; one should dwell in bliss in the kingdom of one's own Self.।

sanskrit: स्वात्मानन्दं स्वयं भोक्ष्येत्स जीवन्मुक्त उच्यते । स्वयमेवैकवीरोऽग्रे स्वयमेव प्रभुः स्मृतः
translit: svātmānandaṃ svayaṃ bhokṣyetsa jīvanmukta ucyate | svayamevaikavīro'gre svayameva prabhuḥ smṛtaḥ
en: He who himself enjoys the bliss of his own Self is called liberated while living; he himself is the one hero in front, he himself is called the lord.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: He who himself enjoys the bliss of his own Self कहलाता है liberated while living; he himself is the one hero in front, he himself कहलाता है the lord.।

sanskrit: ब्रह्मभूतः प्रशान्तात्मा ब्रह्मानन्दमयः सुखी । स्वच्छरूपो महामौनी वैदेही मुक्त एव सः
translit: brahmabhūtaḥ praśāntātmā brahmānandamayaḥ sukhī | svaccharūpo mahāmaunī vaidehī mukta eva saḥ
en: One who has become Brahman, of quiet mind, made of Brahman-bliss, happy, of clear form, a great silent one — he is bodiless and liberated.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: One who has become परब्रह्म, of quiet mind, made of परब्रह्म-bliss, happy, of clear form, a great silent one — he is bodiless and liberated.।

sanskrit: सर्वात्मा समरूपात्मा शुद्धात्मा त्वहमुत्थितः । एकवर्जित एकात्मा सर्वात्मा स्वात्ममात्रकः
translit: sarvātmā samarūpātmā śuddhātmā tvahamutthitaḥ | ekavarjita ekātmā sarvātmā svātmamātrakaḥ
en: The Self of all, of even form, pure Self, I have arisen; free of the one, the one Self, the Self of all, mere own Self.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: आत्मा of all, of even form, pure Self, I have arisen; free of the one, the one Self, आत्मा of all, mere own Self.।

sanskrit: अजात्मा चामृतात्माहं स्वयमात्माहमव्ययः । लक्ष्यात्मा ललितात्माहं तूष्णीमात्मस्वभाववान्
translit: ajātmā cāmṛtātmāhaṃ svayamātmāhamavyayaḥ | lakṣyātmā lalitātmāhaṃ tūṣṇīmātmasvabhāvavān
en: I am the unborn Self, the immortal Self; I am myself the Self, imperishable; the Self as aim, the playful Self, silent, of the nature of the Self.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am the unborn Self, the immortal Self; I am myself आत्मा, imperishable; आत्मा as aim, the playful Self, silent, of the nature of आत्मा.।

sanskrit: आनन्दात्मा प्रियो ह्यात्मा मोक्षात्मा बन्धवर्जितः । ब्रह्मैवाहं चिदेवाहमेवं वापि न चिन्त्यते
translit: ānandātmā priyo hyātmā mokṣātmā bandhavarjitaḥ | brahmaivāhaṃ cidevāhamevaṃ vāpi na cintyate
en: The Self of bliss, the dear Self, the Self of liberation, free of bondage; "I am Brahman alone, I am consciousness alone" — even this is not thought.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: आत्मा of bliss, the dear Self, आत्मा of मोक्ष, free of bondage; "I am परब्रह्म alone, I am चैतन्य alone" — even this is not thought.।

sanskrit: चिन्मात्रेणैव यस्तिष्ठेद्वैदेही मुक्त एव सः
translit: cinmātreṇaiva yastiṣṭhedvaidehī mukta eva saḥ
en: He who stays as mere consciousness alone is bodiless and liberated.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: He who stays as mere चैतन्य alone is bodiless and liberated.।

sanskrit: निश्चयं च परित्यज्य अहं ब्रह्मेति निश्चयम् । आनन्दभरितस्वान्तो वैदेही मुक्त एव सः
translit: niścayaṃ ca parityajya ahaṃ brahmeti niścayam | ānandabharitasvānto vaidehī mukta eva saḥ
en: Abandoning certainty, even the certainty "I am Brahman," with a heart filled with bliss, he is bodiless and liberated.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Abandoning certainty, even the certainty "I am परब्रह्म," with a heart filled with bliss, he is bodiless and liberated.।

sanskrit: सर्वमस्तीति नास्तीति निश्चयं त्यज्य तिष्ठति । अहं ब्रह्मास्मि नास्मीति सच्चिदानन्दमात्रकः
translit: sarvamastīti nāstīti niścayaṃ tyajya tiṣṭhati | ahaṃ brahmāsmi nāsmīti saccidānandamātrakaḥ
en: He stays abandoning the certainty "all exists" or "does not exist"; "I am Brahman" or "I am not" — he is mere being-consciousness-bliss.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: He stays abandoning the certainty "all exists" or "does not exist"; "I am परब्रह्म" or "I am not" — he is mere being-चैतन्य-bliss.।

sanskrit: किञ्चित्क्वचित्कदाचिच्च आत्मानं न स्पृशत्यसौ । तूष्णीमेव स्थितस्तूष्णीं तूष्णीं सत्यं न किञ्चन
translit: kiñcitkvacitkadācicca ātmānaṃ na spṛśatyasau | tūṣṇīmeva sthitastūṣṇīṃ tūṣṇīṃ satyaṃ na kiñcana
en: He does not touch the Self with anything, anywhere, at any time; silent, remaining silent, silent, truth — nothing.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: He does not touch आत्मा with anything, anywhere, at any time; silent, remaining silent, silent, truth — nothing.।

sanskrit: परमात्मा गुणातीतः सर्वात्मा भूतभावनः । कालभेदं वस्तुभेदं देशभेदं स्वभेदकम्
translit: paramātmā guṇātītaḥ sarvātmā bhūtabhāvanaḥ | kālabhedaṃ vastubhedaṃ deśabhedaṃ svabhedakam
en: The Supreme Self, beyond the qualities, the Self of all, the maker of beings' notions: difference of time, difference of things, difference of place, difference of self —
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: परमात्मा, beyond the qualities, आत्मा of all, the maker of beings' notions: difference of time, difference of things, difference of place, difference of self —।

sanskrit: किञ्चिद्भेदं न तस्यास्ति किञ्चिद्वापि न विद्यते । अहं त्वं तदिदं सोऽयं कालात्मा कालहीनकः
translit: kiñcidbhedaṃ na tasyāsti kiñcidvāpi na vidyate | ahaṃ tvaṃ tadidaṃ so'yaṃ kālātmā kālahīnakaḥ
en: of him there is no difference whatever; nor does anything exist at all. "I," "you," "that," "this," "he" — the Self of time, devoid of time.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: of him there is no difference whatever; nor does anything exist at all. "I," "you," "that," "this," "he" — आत्मा of time, devoid of time.।

sanskrit: शून्यात्मा सूक्ष्मरूपात्मा विश्वात्मा विश्वहीनकः । देवात्मादेवहीनात्मा मेयात्मा मेयवर्जितः
translit: śūnyātmā sūkṣmarūpātmā viśvātmā viśvahīnakaḥ | devātmādevahīnātmā meyātmā meyavarjitaḥ
en: The Self of void, of subtle form, the Self of the universe, devoid of the universe; the Self of gods, devoid of gods; the Self of the measurable, free of measure.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: आत्मा of void, of subtle form, आत्मा of the universe, devoid of the universe; आत्मा of gods, devoid of gods; आत्मा of the measurable, free of measure.।

sanskrit: सर्वत्र जडहीनात्मा सर्वेषामन्तरात्मकः । सर्वसङ्कल्पहीनात्मा चिन्मात्रोऽस्मीति सर्वदा
translit: sarvatra jaḍahīnātmā sarveṣāmantarātmakaḥ | sarvasaṅkalpahīnātmā cinmātro'smīti sarvadā
en: Everywhere the Self devoid of dullness, the inner Self of all, the Self devoid of all intentions, always "I am mere consciousness."
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Everywhere आत्मा devoid of dullness, the inner Self of all, आत्मा devoid of all intentions, always "I am mere चैतन्य.।

sanskrit: केवलः परमात्माहं केवलो ज्ञानविग्रहः । सत्तामात्रस्वरूपात्मा नान्यत्किञ्चिज्जगद्भयम्
translit: kevalaḥ paramātmāhaṃ kevalo jñānavigrahaḥ | sattāmātrasvarūpātmā nānyatkiñcijjagadbhayam
en: I am the Supreme Self alone, the body of knowledge alone, the Self of the nature of mere being; no other fear of the world whatever.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am परमात्मा alone, शरीर of ज्ञान alone, आत्मा of the nature of mere being; no other fear of the world whatever.।

sanskrit: जीवेश्वरेति वाक्क्वेति वेदशास्त्राद्यहं त्विति । इदं चैतन्यमेवेति अहं चैतन्यमित्यपि
translit: jīveśvareti vākkveti vedaśāstrādyahaṃ tviti | idaṃ caitanyameveti ahaṃ caitanyamityapi
en: "Individual," "Lord," where are these words? "I am" from Veda and scripture — "this is only consciousness," "I am consciousness" —
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Individual," "Lord," where are these words? "I am" from Veda and scripture — "this is only चैतन्य," "I am चैतन्य" —।

sanskrit: इति निश्चयशून्यो यो वैदेही मुक्त एव सः । चैतन्यमात्रसंसिद्धः स्वात्मारामः सुखासनः
translit: iti niścayaśūnyo yo vaidehī mukta eva saḥ | caitanyamātrasaṃsiddhaḥ svātmārāmaḥ sukhāsanaḥ
en: he who is void even of such certainty is bodiless and liberated. Perfected in mere consciousness, delighting in his own Self, at ease in his seat,
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: he who is void even of such certainty is bodiless and liberated. Perfected in mere चैतन्य, delighting in his own Self, at ease in his seat,।

sanskrit: अपरिच्छिन्नरूपात्मा अणुस्थूलादिवर्जितः । तुर्यतुर्या परानन्दो वैदेही मुक्त एव सः
translit: aparicchinnarūpātmā aṇusthūlādivarjitaḥ | turyaturyā parānando vaidehī mukta eva saḥ
en: of unlimited form, free of atomic, gross and the like, the Fourth of the Fourth, supreme bliss — he is bodiless and liberated.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: of unlimited form, free of atomic, gross and the like, the Fourth of the Fourth, supreme bliss — he is bodiless and liberated.।

sanskrit: नामरूपविहीनात्मा परसंवित्सुखात्मकः । तुरीयातीतरूपात्मा शुभाशुभविवर्जितः
translit: nāmarūpavihīnātmā parasaṃvitsukhātmakaḥ | turīyātītarūpātmā śubhāśubhavivarjitaḥ
en: The Self devoid of name and form, of the nature of the happiness of supreme awareness, of form beyond the Fourth, free of good and bad,
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: आत्मा devoid of name and form, of the nature of the happiness of supreme awareness, of form beyond the Fourth, free of good and bad,।

sanskrit: योगात्मा योगयुक्तात्मा बन्धमोक्षविवर्जितः । गुणागुणविहीनात्मा देशकालादिवर्जितः
translit: yogātmā yogayuktātmā bandhamokṣavivarjitaḥ | guṇāguṇavihīnātmā deśakālādivarjitaḥ
en: the Self of yoga, the yoga-yoked Self, free of bondage and liberation, the Self devoid of quality and non-quality, free of place and time and the rest,
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: आत्मा of yoga, the yoga-yoked Self, free of bondage and मोक्ष, आत्मा devoid of quality and non-quality, free of place and time and the rest,।

sanskrit: साक्ष्यसाक्षित्वहीनात्मा किञ्चित्किञ्चिन्न किञ्चन । यस्य प्रपञ्चमानं न ब्रह्माकारमपीह न
translit: sākṣyasākṣitvahīnātmā kiñcitkiñcinna kiñcana | yasya prapañcamānaṃ na brahmākāramapīha na
en: the Self devoid of witness and non-witness, something and nothing, none at all; in whom there is no measure of the world, nor even Brahman-form here.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: आत्मा devoid of witness and non-witness, something and nothing, none at all; in whom there is no measure of the world, nor even परब्रह्म-form here.।

sanskrit: स्वस्वरूपे स्वयञ्ज्योतिः स्वस्वरूपे स्वयंरतिः । वाचामगोचरानन्दो वाङ्मनोगोचरः स्वयम्
translit: svasvarūpe svayañjyotiḥ svasvarūpe svayaṃratiḥ | vācāmagocarānando vāṅmanogocaraḥ svayam
en: In his own nature self-luminous, in his own nature self-delighting; bliss beyond speech's reach, himself within reach of speech and mind;
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: In his own nature self-luminous, in his own nature self-delighting; bliss beyond speech's reach, himself within reach of speech and mind;।

sanskrit: अतीतातीतभावो यो वैदेही मुक्त एव सः । चित्तवृत्तेरतीतो यश्चित्तवृत्त्यवभासकः
translit: atītātītabhāvo yo vaidehī mukta eva saḥ | cittavṛtteratīto yaścittavṛttyavabhāsakaḥ
en: he whose state is beyond the beyond is bodiless and liberated. Who is beyond the mind's modification, the illuminator of the mind's modification,
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: he whose state is beyond the beyond is bodiless and liberated. Who is beyond मन's modification, the illuminator of मन's modification,।

sanskrit: सर्ववृत्तिविहीनात्मा वैदेही मुक्त एव सः । तस्मिन्काले विदेहीति देहस्मरणवर्जितः
translit: sarvavṛttivihīnātmā vaidehī mukta eva saḥ | tasminkāle videhīti dehasmaraṇavarjitaḥ
en: the Self devoid of all modification is bodiless and liberated. At that time "bodiless," free of remembering the body;
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: आत्मा devoid of all modification is bodiless and liberated. At that time "bodiless," free of remembering शरीर;।

sanskrit: ईषन्मात्रं स्मृतं चेद्यस्तदा सर्वसमन्वितः । परैरदृष्टबाह्यात्मा परमानन्दचिद्धनः
translit: īṣanmātraṃ smṛtaṃ cedyastadā sarvasamanvitaḥ | parairadṛṣṭabāhyātmā paramānandaciddhanaḥ
en: if he remembers even slightly, then he is endowed with all; unseen by others in his outer self, a mass of supreme bliss and consciousness;
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: if he remembers even slightly, then he is endowed with all; unseen by others in his outer self, a mass of supreme bliss and चैतन्य;।

sanskrit: परैरदृष्टबाह्यात्मा सर्ववेदान्तगोचरः । ब्रह्मामृतरसास्वादो ब्रह्मामृतरसायनः
translit: parairadṛṣṭabāhyātmā sarvavedāntagocaraḥ | brahmāmṛtarasāsvādo brahmāmṛtarasāyanaḥ
en: unseen by others in his outer self, within the reach of all Vedanta; tasting the nectar-savor of Brahman, the elixir of Brahman-nectar-savor;
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: unseen by others in his outer self, within the reach of all Vedanta; tasting the nectar-savor of परब्रह्म, the elixir of परब्रह्म-nectar-savor;।

sanskrit: ब्रह्मामृतरसासक्तो ब्रह्मामृतरसः स्वयम् । ब्रह्मामृतरसे मग्नो ब्रह्मानन्दशिवार्चनः
translit: brahmāmṛtarasāsakto brahmāmṛtarasaḥ svayam | brahmāmṛtarase magno brahmānandaśivārcanaḥ
en: attached to the nectar-savor of Brahman, himself the nectar-savor of Brahman; immersed in the nectar-savor of Brahman, worshipping Shiva in Brahman-bliss;
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: attached to the nectar-savor of परब्रह्म, himself the nectar-savor of परब्रह्म; immersed in the nectar-savor of परब्रह्म, worshipping Shiva in परब्रह्म-bliss;।

sanskrit: ब्रह्मामृतरसे तृप्तो ब्रह्मानन्दानुभावकः । ब्रह्मानन्दशिवानन्दो ब्रह्मानन्दरसप्रभः
translit: brahmāmṛtarase tṛpto brahmānandānubhāvakaḥ | brahmānandaśivānando brahmānandarasaprabhaḥ
en: satisfied by the nectar-savor of Brahman, an experiencer of Brahman-bliss; Brahman-bliss and Shiva-bliss, radiant with the savor of Brahman-bliss;
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: satisfied by the nectar-savor of परब्रह्म, an experiencer of परब्रह्म-bliss; परब्रह्म-bliss and Shiva-bliss, radiant with the savor of परब्रह्म-bliss;।

sanskrit: ब्रह्मानन्दपरं ज्योतिर्ब्रह्मानन्दनिरन्तरः । ब्रह्मानन्दरसान्नादो ब्रह्मानन्दकुटुम्बकः
translit: brahmānandaparaṃ jyotirbrahmānandanirantaraḥ | brahmānandarasānnādo brahmānandakuṭumbakaḥ
en: the supreme light of Brahman-bliss, continuous in Brahman-bliss; with the sound of the food of Brahman-bliss-savor, a family of Brahman-bliss;
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: the supreme light of परब्रह्म-bliss, continuous in परब्रह्म-bliss; with the sound of the food of परब्रह्म-bliss-savor, a family of परब्रह्म-bliss;।

sanskrit: ब्रह्मानन्दरसारूढो ब्रह्मानन्दैकचिद्धनः । ब्रह्मानन्दरसोद्बाहो ब्रह्मानन्दरसम्भरः
translit: brahmānandarasārūḍho brahmānandaikaciddhanaḥ | brahmānandarasodbāho brahmānandarasambharaḥ
en: mounted on the savor of Brahman-bliss, a sole mass of Brahman-bliss consciousness; bearing the savor of Brahman-bliss, filled with the savor of Brahman-bliss;
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: mounted on the savor of परब्रह्म-bliss, a sole mass of परब्रह्म-bliss चैतन्य; bearing the savor of परब्रह्म-bliss, filled with the savor of परब्रह्म-bliss;।

sanskrit: ब्रह्मानन्दजनैर्युक्तो ब्रह्मानन्दात्मनि स्थितः । आत्मरूपमिदं सर्वमात्मनोऽन्यन्न कञ्चन
translit: brahmānandajanairyukto brahmānandātmani sthitaḥ | ātmarūpamidaṃ sarvamātmano'nyanna kañcana
en: joined with those of Brahman-bliss, established in the Self of Brahman-bliss. All this is of the nature of the Self; nothing is other than the Self.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: joined with those of परब्रह्म-bliss, established in आत्मा of परब्रह्म-bliss. All this is of the nature of आत्मा; nothing is other than आत्मा.।

sanskrit: सर्वमात्माहमात्मास्मि परमात्मा परात्मकः । नित्यानन्द स्वरूपात्मा वैदेही मुक्त एव सः
translit: sarvamātmāhamātmāsmi paramātmā parātmakaḥ | nityānanda svarūpātmā vaidehī mukta eva saḥ
en: All is the Self; I am the Self; the Supreme Self, the highest; of the nature of eternal bliss — he is bodiless and liberated.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: All is आत्मा; I am आत्मा; परमात्मा, the highest; of the nature of eternal bliss — he is bodiless and liberated.।

sanskrit: पूर्णरूपो महानात्मा प्रीतात्मा शाश्वतात्मकः । सर्वान्तर्यामिरूपात्मा निर्मलात्मा निरात्मकः
translit: pūrṇarūpo mahānātmā prītātmā śāśvatātmakaḥ | sarvāntaryāmirūpātmā nirmalātmā nirātmakaḥ
en: Of full form, the great Self, the pleased Self, the everlasting Self, of the form of the inner controller of all, the stainless Self, the selfless;
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Of full form, the great Self, the pleased Self, the everlasting Self, of the form of the inner controller of all, the stainless Self, the selfless;।

sanskrit: निर्विकारस्वरूपात्मा शुद्धात्मा शान्तरूपकः । शान्ताशान्तस्वरूपात्मा नैकात्मत्वविवर्जितः
translit: nirvikārasvarūpātmā śuddhātmā śāntarūpakaḥ | śāntāśāntasvarūpātmā naikātmatvavivarjitaḥ
en: of changeless nature, pure Self, of peaceful form; the Self of peaceful and unpeaceful nature, free of the sense of unity of the Self;
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: of changeless nature, pure Self, of peaceful form; आत्मा of peaceful and unpeaceful nature, free of the sense of unity of आत्मा;।

sanskrit: जीवात्मपरमात्मेति चिन्तासर्वस्ववर्जितः । मुक्तामुक्तस्वरूपात्मा मुक्तामुक्तविवर्जितः
translit: jīvātmaparamātmeti cintāsarvasvavarjitaḥ | muktāmuktasvarūpātmā muktāmuktavivarjitaḥ
en: free of the thought "individual self, supreme Self," whose Self is of liberated and unliberated nature, free of liberated and unliberated;
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: free of the thought "individual self, supreme Self," whose Self is of liberated and unliberated nature, free of liberated and unliberated;।

sanskrit: बन्धमोक्षस्वरूपात्मा बन्धमोक्षविवर्जितः । द्वैताद्वैतस्वरूपात्मा द्वैताद्वैतविवर्जितः
translit: bandhamokṣasvarūpātmā bandhamokṣavivarjitaḥ | dvaitādvaitasvarūpātmā dvaitādvaitavivarjitaḥ
en: the Self of the nature of bondage and liberation, free of bondage and liberation; the Self of dual and non-dual nature, free of dual and non-dual;
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: आत्मा of the nature of bondage and मोक्ष, free of bondage and मोक्ष; आत्मा of dual and non-dual nature, free of dual and non-dual;।

sanskrit: सर्वासर्वस्वरूपात्मा सर्वासर्वविवर्जितः । मोदप्रमोदरूपात्मा मोदादिविनिवर्जितः
translit: sarvāsarvasvarūpātmā sarvāsarvavivarjitaḥ | modapramodarūpātmā modādivinivarjitaḥ
en: the Self of the nature of all and not-all, free of all and not-all; of the form of joy and great joy, free of joy and the rest;
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: आत्मा of the nature of all and not-all, free of all and not-all; of the form of joy and great joy, free of joy and the rest;।

sanskrit: सर्वसङ्कल्पहीनात्मा वैदेही मुक्त एव सः । निष्कलात्मा निर्मलात्मा बुद्धात्मापुरुषात्मकः
translit: sarvasaṅkalpahīnātmā vaidehī mukta eva saḥ | niṣkalātmā nirmalātmā buddhātmāpuruṣātmakaḥ
en: the Self devoid of all intentions is bodiless and liberated. The partless Self, the stainless Self, the awakened Self, the non-person Self;
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: आत्मा devoid of all intentions is bodiless and liberated. The partless Self, the stainless Self, the awakened Self, the non-person Self;।

sanskrit: आनन्दादिविहीनात्मा अमृतात्मामृतात्मकः । कालत्रयस्वरूपात्मा कालत्रयविवर्जितः
translit: ānandādivihīnātmā amṛtātmāmṛtātmakaḥ | kālatrayasvarūpātmā kālatrayavivarjitaḥ
en: the Self devoid of bliss and the rest, the immortal Self, of immortal nature; of the nature of the three times, free of the three times;
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: आत्मा devoid of bliss and the rest, the immortal Self, of immortal nature; of the nature of the three times, free of the three times;।

sanskrit: अखिलात्मा ह्यमेयात्मा मानात्मा मानवर्जितः । नित्यप्रत्यक्षरूपात्मा नित्यप्रत्यक्षनिर्णयः
translit: akhilātmā hyameyātmā mānātmā mānavarjitaḥ | nityapratyakṣarūpātmā nityapratyakṣanirṇayaḥ
en: the entire Self, the immeasurable Self, the Self of measure, free of measure; the Self of eternally evident nature, the determination of the eternally evident;
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: the entire Self, the immeasurable Self, आत्मा of measure, free of measure; आत्मा of eternally evident nature, the determination of the eternally evident;।

sanskrit: अन्यहीनस्वभावात्मा अन्यहीनस्वयम्प्रभः । विद्याविद्यादिमेयात्मा विद्याविद्यादिवर्जितः
translit: anyahīnasvabhāvātmā anyahīnasvayamprabhaḥ | vidyāvidyādimeyātmā vidyāvidyādivarjitaḥ
en: of nature devoid of another, self-luminous devoid of another; the Self measured by knowledge and ignorance and the like, free of knowledge and ignorance;
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: of nature devoid of another, self-luminous devoid of another; आत्मा measured by ज्ञान and अविद्या and the like, free of ज्ञान and अविद्या;।

sanskrit: नित्यानित्यविहीनात्मा इहामुत्रविवर्जितः । शमादिषट्कशून्यात्मा मुमुक्षुत्वादिवर्जितः
translit: nityānityavihīnātmā ihāmutravivarjitaḥ | śamādiṣaṭkaśūnyātmā mumukṣutvādivarjitaḥ
en: the Self devoid of eternal and non-eternal, free of here and hereafter; the Self empty of the sixfold means beginning with peace, free of the desire for liberation and the like;
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: आत्मा devoid of eternal and non-eternal, free of here and hereafter; आत्मा empty of the sixfold means beginning with peace, free of the desire for मोक्ष and the like;।

sanskrit: स्थूलदेहविहीनात्मा सूक्ष्मदेहविवर्जितः । कारणादिविहीनात्मा तुरीयादिविवर्जितः
translit: sthūladehavihīnātmā sūkṣmadehavivarjitaḥ | kāraṇādivihīnātmā turīyādivivarjitaḥ
en: the Self devoid of the gross body, free of the subtle body; the Self devoid of cause and the rest, free of the Fourth and the rest;
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: आत्मा devoid of the gross body, free of the subtle body; आत्मा devoid of cause and the rest, free of the Fourth and the rest;।

sanskrit: अन्नकोशविहीनात्मा प्राणकोशविवर्जितः । मनःकोशविहीनात्मा विज्ञानादिविवर्जितः
translit: annakośavihīnātmā prāṇakośavivarjitaḥ | manaḥkośavihīnātmā vijñānādivivarjitaḥ
en: the Self devoid of the food-sheath, free of the breath-sheath; the Self devoid of the mind-sheath, free of the knowledge-sheath and the rest;
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: आत्मा devoid of the food-sheath, free of the breath-sheath; आत्मा devoid of मन-sheath, free of the ज्ञान-sheath and the rest;।

sanskrit: आनन्दकोशहीनात्मा पञ्चकोशविवर्जितः । निर्विकल्पस्वरूपात्मा सविकल्पविवर्जितः
translit: ānandakośahīnātmā pañcakośavivarjitaḥ | nirvikalpasvarūpātmā savikalpavivarjitaḥ
en: the Self devoid of the bliss-sheath, free of the five sheaths; the Self of non-conceptual nature, free of the conceptual;
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: आत्मा devoid of the bliss-sheath, free of the five sheaths; आत्मा of non-conceptual nature, free of the conceptual;।

sanskrit: दृश्यानुविद्धहीनात्मा शब्दविद्धविवर्जितः । सदा समाधिशून्यात्मा आदिमध्यान्तवर्जितः
translit: dṛśyānuviddhahīnātmā śabdaviddhavivarjitaḥ | sadā samādhiśūnyātmā ādimadhyāntavarjitaḥ
en: the Self devoid of association with the seen, free of association with sound; always the Self empty of samadhi, free of beginning, middle and end;
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: आत्मा devoid of association with the seen, free of association with sound; always आत्मा empty of samadhi, free of beginning, middle and end;।

sanskrit: प्रज्ञानवाक्यहीनात्मा अहम्ब्रह्मास्मिवर्जितः । तत्त्वमस्यादिहीनात्मा अयमात्मेत्यभावकः
translit: prajñānavākyahīnātmā ahambrahmāsmivarjitaḥ | tattvamasyādihīnātmā ayamātmetyabhāvakaḥ
en: the Self devoid of the saying "consciousness is Brahman," free of "I am Brahman"; the Self devoid of "That thou art" and the like, without the notion "this Self";
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: आत्मा devoid of the saying "चैतन्य is परब्रह्म," free of "I am परब्रह्म"; आत्मा devoid of "That thou art" and the like, without the notion "this Self";।

sanskrit: ओङ्कारवाच्यहीनात्मा सर्ववाच्यविवर्जितः । अवस्थात्रयहीनात्मा अक्षरात्मा चिदात्मकः
translit: oṅkāravācyahīnātmā sarvavācyavivarjitaḥ | avasthātrayahīnātmā akṣarātmā cidātmakaḥ
en: the Self devoid of what Om signifies, free of all that can be said; the Self devoid of the three states, the imperishable Self, of the nature of consciousness;
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: आत्मा devoid of what Om signifies, free of all that can be कहा; आत्मा devoid of the three states, the imperishable Self, of the nature of चैतन्य;।

sanskrit: आत्मज्ञेयादिहीनात्मा यत्किञ्चिदिदमात्मकः । भानाभानविहीनात्मा वैदेही मुक्त एव सः
translit: ātmajñeyādihīnātmā yatkiñcididamātmakaḥ | bhānābhānavihīnātmā vaidehī mukta eva saḥ
en: the Self devoid of the knowable and the like, whatever this is of Self; the Self devoid of appearing and non-appearing — he is bodiless and liberated.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: आत्मा devoid of the knowable and the like, whatever this is of Self; आत्मा devoid of appearing and non-appearing — he is bodiless and liberated.।

sanskrit: आत्मानमेव वीक्षस्व आत्मानं बोधय स्वकम् । स्वमात्मानं स्वयं भुङ्क्ष्व स्वस्थो भव षडानन
translit: ātmānameva vīkṣasva ātmānaṃ bodhaya svakam | svamātmānaṃ svayaṃ bhuṅkṣva svastho bhava ṣaḍānana
en: Look at the Self alone; awaken your own Self; by yourself enjoy your own Self; be established in yourself, O six-faced one.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Look at आत्मा alone; awaken your own Self; by yourself enjoy your own Self; be established in yourself, O six-faced one.।
